text:
katie: Quick design review: dark theme tweaks — dropping the new "eclipse" palette + syntax samples. QA flagged a couple of accessibility nits for metrics and small text. Please review Figma & quick comments below.

oliver: Can you paste the Figma link? want to see the panels in context.

katie: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/Eclipse-Theme-Console — go to page "Dashboards / Dark". Also uploaded a screenshot in the thread :eyes:

maria: Chart colors look good as a set but the green (#3fe68a) reads too bright on dark bg. Suggest reduce saturation and maybe shift hue slightly toward teal so it doesn't clash with success tint.

sam: Noted. For syntax, function names are almost same contrast as comments at 12px. Proposed token update:
```css
--code-fg: #E6EEF7; /* body code */
--code-fn: #9BD5FF; /* functions */
--code-kw: #CBB8FF; /* keywords */
--code-cm: #7A8A97; /* comments */
```
Would increase pop without being neon.

katie: I like `--code-fn: #9BD5FF`. Sam can you run a quick contrast check on that vs the panel bg (#0f1417)?

lena: Small text (metrics in the list) failed contrast at 12px: ratio 3.9:1. For body text we need >=4.5:1. Options: increase font-weight to 600, or nudge bg to #0c1113 (slightly lighter) or increase fg to #E9F0F6.

oliver: For charts, also consider colorblind-safe ordering. We should avoid red/green as first two for common combos. Maybe use a palette like:
`#7fb3ff, #f6b26b, #8fe68a, #d3a4ff, #ffd47f` — tested with coblis.

maria: If we switch green hue, update legend swatches and stacked area default so they don't get lost when thin lines overlap.

jo: Copy nit: settings label currently reads "Dark theme intensity". Suggest shorter "Theme contrast" or "Theme darkness"? I vote "Theme contrast" since it's what users tune.

katie: Agreed on "Theme contrast". Also let's add a tooltip copy: "Adjust contrast for better readability under different lighting" — short and clear.

sam: I'll push a PR with token changes + chart palette + updated tooltip. Will include unit tests for contrast using axe-core.

design-bot: Snapshot saved: Figma page "Dashboards / Dark" — version 3.4.2

katie: Action items: Sam update tokens, Maria adjust chart swatches, Lena run accessibility check on updated build. Hold for staging review. :thumbsup: :shipit:
